name: How does AKN Design Group's design-build process work for garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group's design-build process work for garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process for garage conversions unifies design and construction under one accountable team. It begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, followed by detailed design planning, including CAD-supported layouts. Once the design is finalized and permits are secured, our experienced construction team executes the project, maintaining clear communication and scheduling transparency. The process culminates in a final walkthrough, ensuring the transformed space meets our high standards of craftsmanship and your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design-build process covers consultation, detailed design with CAD, permit coordination, construction, and a final walkthrough, all under one team. Clear communication is key.
